name: A Courtesan of Rome
source:
Make your debut as a courtesan in Ancient Rome and plot your vengeance against Julius Caesar for his conquest of your homeland.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/A_Courtesan_of_Rome]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
以交际花的身份初登古罗马的舞台，谋划向征服你故乡的尤利乌斯·凯撒复仇。
